props.gloss_en: the mishna: at three occasions in the year the priests lift their hands four times in the day: at shacharit, musaf, mincha and the closing of the gates
the mishna: [the three occasions are] the fasts

the mishna is defective and teaches thus: at three occasions priests lift their hands whenever they pray, and among them there are [days of] four times a day -- shacharit, musaf, mincha and the closing of the gates; and these are the three occasions: fasts, maamadot and Yom Kippur

objections.gloss_en: תעניות ומעמדות מי איכא מוסף? -- fasts and maamadot have no musaf, so how can the priests lift their hands four times a day on them?
